verdict.rationale: Apple's own Mac help documents a built-in automation tool, "Automate tasks with Shortcuts" (macos-docs-19). Community users corroborate scripting repetitive work with built-in command-line tools, such as piping `pbpaste | json_pp | pbcopy` to clean up clipboard data (macos-docs-19, macos-comm-13). The first-party evidence is only a single heading, though, so the depth of Shortcuts is unshown. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Shortcuts actions, triggers and scheduling, evidence of other built-in scripting (e.g. AppleScript/Automator), and independent hands-on reports of Shortcuts automating real repetitive tasks.
